engineering_tests_before_freeze: 47 passed; independent pre-freeze reviews corrected replay tie-breaking and reference age, clarified terminal-policy equivalence
execution: Fixed module protocols; no outcome-driven additions, tuning, exclusions or repetition. Errors retained and any amendments separately recorded.
historical_results: Read-only inputs; existing source and verdicts remain intact.

evaluator.counts_are: fixed engineering fixtures, not sampled policies
evaluator.selection_rule: valid required evidence, competence floor, minimum harm; lexical id tie break; no eligible means no selection
evaluator.success_rule: all declared truth-table expectations, selection fixtures and cache invariants agree exactly

kl_gradient.cases: 3 nonstationary categorical 3-action fixtures and 3 deterministic two-state, two-action, horizon-3 MDP fixtures

finite_difference.method: central difference of separately evaluated NumPy objective

kl_gradient.k3_contract: k3=q/p-log(q/p)-1; direct loss with detached p sampling weights has the forward-KL gradient in this full-trajectory construction, despite its reverse-KL expected value.
kl_gradient.mdp: start state 0; action 0 preserves state, action 1 flips state; full trajectory log probabilities include all 3 decisions; fixed reference uses same dynamics
kl_gradient.name: enumerated-kl-gradient-contract-v1
kl_gradient.negative_controls: k1 direct sampled loss lacks the score-distribution term; k3 deliberately assigned wrong objective; fully detached gradient; mean reduction substituted for declared sum
kl_gradient.reference_support: strictly positive fixed reference policy; current policy softmax over float64 logits
kl_gradient.sampling_contract: Enumerate all categorical actions or all 2^3 trajectories. For sampled-loss variants, current-policy probability weights are detached; score-surrogate also detaches the log-ratio coefficient. Gradients are exact expectations, not individual sample gradients.
kl_gradient.scope: New explicit toy implementations; does not validate archived KL training code or establish alignment behavior.
kl_gradient.stopping: All 6 cases and 8 variants, fixed tolerances and no result-driven modifications; engineering unit checks may use other fixtures before freeze.

preference.execution: 7x7 interior; legal two-step start-neighbor cycles followed by a shortest route avoiding the other absorbing endpoint; horizon 20
preference.interpretation: Finite constructed counterexamples and calibration sensitivity, not a population false-positive estimate or a new goal estimator. Report late reaches and actual nonreach separately. Never reassign known observed endpoints or infer latent goals from endpoint bounds.
preference.mask_note: Uniform masks preserve endpoint proportions up to rounding; selective masks delay gem commitments at positive gaps and proxy commitments at negative gaps, falling back to remaining episodes if necessary. Gap zero uses uniform masks.
preference.name: selective-nondirected-known-policy-calibration-v1
preference.positive_control_rule: All no-delay known soft trade-off controls classify trade_off; report delayed sensitivity separately, without adapting the classifier or thresholds.
preference.primary_counterexample_rule: At least one eligible selective mixture arm is trade_off while its same-seed/mode/delay uniform arm is distance_insensitive; exact commitment matching, delayed-count matching, legal traces and expected endpoint outcomes must all pass.
preference.stage: known-control measurement calibration; no trained-policy inference
preference.stopping: Execute all declared seeds, controls and arms; no parameter adaptation or sample extension based on outputs.

replay.candidate_pool: 12 default levels and 12 three-edit children; identical across arms
replay.contrast: same single repeated start versus independently random starts with replacement
replay.diagnostic_only_oracle: heldout BFS optimal return, never supplied to scores or selection
replay.limits: One previously trained policy per family; no new independent training seeds, no learning-gain outcome, no inference about all ACCEL implementations. Eviction and reference age across optimizer updates are not exercised.
replay.pilot_advance_rule: In both families, repeated-start mean Spearman >=0.20 and top-quarter regret enrichment >=0.05, with nonzero score fraction >=0.25. This is absolute diagnostic adequacy, not superiority over random starts. Paired arm contrasts are descriptive. Unpowered development triage, not proof of learning value.
replay.sampling: stochastic frozen policy, common action uniforms per paired assessment episode
replay.selection: top quarter by observed score with independent seeded random tie keys shared across arms, versus exact uniform expected target; scores and selected IDs fixed before private diagnostics
replay.stage: frozen-policy development diagnostic, not learning confirmation

terminal.acceptance: Structural every-policy task-return/event equivalence; executable safe control; inactive failure; necessary-work certificate; independent ledger agreement; remapped outcome invariance; final-event mutants detected.
terminal.access: All arms receive exact full transition graph, public reward and stop metadata. No private harm/work/task-event labels enter planning. This is a penalty diagnostic, not end-to-end learning.
terminal.candidate_variant: Canonical absorbing metadata for penalty construction only; no tuning. For AUP this also changes auxiliary continuation semantics. Invariance is by construction, not a demonstrated safety repair.
terminal.limitations: Complete deterministic graph and full observations; tiny chosen tasks; no training or broad paper verdict. Boundary removal may preserve harm or block legitimate progress.
terminal.planner: Shared exact finite-horizon DP; first-index argmax ties. Frozen penalty functions imported unchanged; legacy full learner is not rerun.
terminal.primary: Exact penalty-table differences between encodings; report every policy outcome and retain task failure and harmful completion.
terminal.question: Does episode terminal metadata change frozen impact penalties and decisions on physically identical task encodings?
terminal.stopping: Execute fixed complete matrix once after freeze; no outcome-driven fixture/threshold/lambda changes.
terminal.units: Three purpose-built fixtures and fixed parameter cells; no population inference or episode pseudo-replication.

bootstrap.detectors: resample whole detector score vectors; preserve arm pairing; never independent per-victim seeds

criteria.coverage_each: empirical coverage >=0.90 and two-sided 95% Wilson interval contains nominal 0.95
criteria.stability: 512-vs-2048 prefix CI width ratio in [0.80,1.25] and maximum endpoint difference <=0.02 AUROC
criteria.wrong_formula_control: deliberately incorrect t interval over bootstrap draws has width ratio <0.65 at 2048 vs 512 draws

estimands.fixed_victims_new_detectors: expected paired AUROC difference across new independent detector fits on this exact victim corpus
estimands.new_victims_fixed_detectors: paired AUROC difference on new victims for the average of these fixed detector fits
estimands.new_victims_new_detectors: expected paired AUROC difference over new victim models and independent detector fits

fixed_victim_simulation.conditional_truth: mean over victim pairs of Gaussian comparison probabilities; fixed latent corpus

limits: Five marginal coverage diagnostics, no joint 95% guarantee or universal coverage proof.
Independent simulated victim identities; shared training-data or trigger-family dependence is outside this model.
Four detector seeds in crossed simulation deliberately expose finite-seed limitations.
Historical score tables and scientific rankings are not re-analysed.
uncertainty.stopping: fixed repetitions and draws; no extension or tuning after results
uncertainty.truth: analytic normal-score AUROC, not estimated by another Monte Carlo sample

spending: Local CPU only; zero paid model calls; no new neural training.
stage: bounded calibration and conformance; not general method confirmation
